title: Page 10
content_zh:
温宁回来后便站在床前，居高临下地看着他，冷冰冰地说：“回你自己房间去。”
“我不要。”他把被子拉得高高的。
温宁拧眉去扯被子，肖崇源就一脸惊慌地拚命拉着被子，“我们谈谈。”
“从床上下来我们再谈。”
“骗人，等我下来你就会把我轰走。”
“你要谈什么？”
“模特儿大赛的事。”
“你不是坚决不同意的吗？”温宁挑高了眉毛。
“你躺到我旁边，我们好好商量一下。”
“呋！”温宁像看色狼一样看着他。
“反正我是不会站着和你谈的，以防你随时会把我赶走。”肖崇源半张脸都被遮着，看起来有些滑稽，“今天不谈也可以，那我明天就跟着你去上班，我们总会有时间好好聊聊的。”他说完很认真地看了温宁一眼，接着郑重地闭上眼。
真是越来越无赖了，温宁无言地翻了个白眼，最终只好无奈地躺到他旁边，生硬地说：“谈吧。”
肖崇源翻过身侧躺在床上，眼巴巴地看着她，“其实要我做你的指导也不是不可以，但你要答应我一件事，别急着拒绝我，如果你不肯，那我仍坚决不同意，但我会用别的方法让你和我复婚，你考虑一下，是答应我一个很容易做到的条件呢，还是面对一个更加死缠烂打的我呢？”
第9章(2)
死缠烂打？他对自己的定位还真是准确，温宁冷着脸，斜看着面对自己躺着的肖崇源，
“什么条件？”
“比赛全程我必须跟着你。”
“就这样？”
“是。”肖崇源重重地点头，“我都会为你打点好的。”
“真的？”温宁狐疑地看着他。

“相信我，我都说过不会再骗你了。”肖崇源信誓旦旦地作保证，见温宁表情软化之后忍不住往前凑了凑，“那复婚的事还可以考虑喔？”
“等大赛顺利开始了之后再说。”
“我一定不会去捣乱的，放心好了。”肖崇源的手悄悄地伸过去，“那么……”
“你干嘛？把手拿开。”
“你要去参加模特儿大赛，好歹给我吃个定心丸吧。”
“什么定心丸？”温宁的注意力被转移，没发现他渐渐蠕动过来。
“你知道我不喜欢漂亮女人，放在家里很不安心，现在你还要去参加比赛，我更担心了。”
他的意思是说自己很漂亮？不过听起来好奇怪。
“所以我都答应指导你比赛了，你难道不该做点什么让我安心？”
“你指导我比赛是我对你的考验，不是……喂，你把手拿开啦，还摸？”
“来吧，老婆，让我安安心……”
“谁是你老婆，不要乱叫，啊……你老实一点行不行？”
肖崇源忽然扑上去，扯起被子把两个人裹了起来。
光线忽然变得好暗，在密闭的空间内，两人温热的呼吸都纠缠在一起，温宁闪躲着肖崇源的亲吻，索性把头埋进他的颈窝不出来，他吻不到红唇，就用手上上下下在她身上点火，不断地吻着她的肩膀。
当温宁终于忍不住将头抬起来喘息的时候，肖崇源便立刻凑上去封住了她的唇，勾着她的小舌，配合着自己的节奏起舞，“阿宁……”
“嗯……啊。”温宁腰一抬，感觉到他的炽热滑了进来，瞬间将她撑满。
“你是我的。”肖崇源深深地吻着她，一面缓慢地律|动一面呢喃：“永远都跑不掉……”
昏暗的灯光下，床单下的两个躯体起伏着、纠缠着，强烈的运动令床单卷了起来，露出肖崇源的长腿，他的膝盖抵着床，臀部有力地往前撞击，而温宁白皙的小腿就绕在他身上，像是无助的藤蔓。
温宁偶尔会忽然把手伸出来，用力地抓住被单，但很快又被肖崇源拉了回去，大床因为他们的运动而吱呀作响，吱呀的响声和男女性感的喘息声，过了许久之后才停止。
报名参加比赛过后，温宁才知道肖崇源打的是什么如意算盘。

他是全程陪同没错，但居然连化妆师和服装造型师都帮她找好了，清一色的全是女人，让她完全没有接触异性的可能性。
温宁怎么会不明白他的心思，暗骂了一句真是幼稚，但心头还是不由自主地开心。
只不过大家都在同一间化妆室里，其他人的化妆师有男有女，这让肖崇源如临大敌。
“你这样太过分了吧。”温宁看着化妆镜中穿着过膝棉制睡袍的自己，苦着一张脸，“这样子好热。”
肖崇源按着她的肩膀，“那也不能脱，我已经打听过了，这次的评委里只有三个男人，我刚刚和工作人员交代过，把你安排在离男评委最远的地方，对了，有一个评委叫做余野，记得离他远一点。”他说着伸手帮温宁擦了擦汗。
“为什么？”
“他是余放的哥哥，这次大赛的主办者。”
“那我不应该凑得更近才对？”
“他又不认识你，凑近也没用。”肖崇源没好气地说：“你不是要靠自己的努力吗，我可不会让你走后门。”
温宁耸了耸肩，说得这么好听，反正就是不准她穿着泳衣靠近异性就是了。
这次的初选虽然必须要穿泳衣，但幸亏没有观众，要不然肖崇源又无法冷静了，不过温宁还是低估肖崇源了，在之后的几次选拔中，他硬是逼得好友余野比赛时不准放观众进来。
“就算没观众，到时候也是要直播的。”
“能少一样是一样，
“要是这么介意，我不如帮你直接把她淘汰掉？”
“这个不行。”肖崇源想也没想就拒绝了。
“为什么？”
“因为这是她的梦想。”
虽然很排斥温宁参加比赛，但肖崇源知道温宁为此付出了多大的努力，他不能因为一己私欲，就让她之前所受的羞辱和委屈都白费。
如果这真的是她想要的，那么他不想让她留有遗憾，更何况温宁自身的条件确实很优秀，如果抛开个人的看法，他觉得这次模特儿比赛的冠军非她莫属。
她美丽、睿智又勇敢，每一场比赛她都认真准备，毫不怯场，表现好得出乎意料，或许她从没有舞台经验，所以她不曾发觉自己竟是如此适合这个舞台。

肖崇源看着温宁站在聚光灯下的那一瞬，觉得心跳都要停止了，她脸上的笑容\'走路的姿态、摆手的幅度都那么无懈可击，一场一场比下来，她进步的速度快得惊人，就连极反对她做模特儿的他都觉得，她可能一开始就进错了公司，耽误了她的前程。
以她的资质，成为顶级模特儿是迟早的事。
“幸亏你当初没采纳我的提议。”余野看着舞台上的温宁，“要不然我们公司会错失一个很优秀的人才。”
肖崇源若有所思，“你觉得她能夺冠？”
余野摸了摸下巴，“她是这批选手中综合素质最好的，才比了三场，已经有公司要签她了。”
余野收回目光，“我听说她之前做了两年的模特儿助理？到底是什么样的老板，居然埋没了她整整两年。”
他无法理解地笑了笑，接着又将目光转了回去。
肖崇源的脸色却渐渐黯淡下来，如果离婚前他不那么反对温宁的决定，或许她不用灰头土脸地离家出走实现模特儿梦，或许她会有一个更体面的开始，也不至于受这么多罪。
肖崇源深深地凝视着在舞台准备区站定的温宁，他自她比赛开始就无比纠结的心终于平静了下来。

After Wen Ning came back, he stood in front of the bed, looked at him condescendingly, and said coldly: "Go back to your room."
"I don't want it." He pulled the quilt up high.
Wen Ning frowned and pulled the quilt, but Xiao Chongyuan pulled the quilt with all his strength with a panicked look on his face, "Let's talk."
"Get out of bed and we'll talk."
"Liar, when I come down you will blast me away."
"What do you want to talk about?"
"It's about the modeling contest."
"Don't you firmly disagree?" Wen Ning raised his eyebrows.
"Lie next to me and let's discuss it."
"Fuck!" Wen Ning looked at him like a pervert.
"Anyway, I won't stand and talk to you, in case you drive me away at any time." Xiao Chongyuan looked a little funny with half of his face covered, "It's okay if we don't talk today, then I will follow you to work tomorrow. We will always have time to have a good chat." After he finished speaking, he looked at Wen Ning seriously, and then closed his eyes solemnly.
He was getting more and more rogue. Wen Ning rolled his eyes wordlessly, and finally had no choice but to lie down next to him and said stiffly: "Let's talk."
Xiao Chongyuan turned over and lay on his side on the bed, looking at her longingly, "Actually, it's not impossible for me to be your guide, but you have to promise me one thing. Don't refuse me in a hurry. If you don't agree, then I still firmly disagree, but I will use other methods to get you to remarry me. Think about it, should you agree to a condition that is easy to achieve, or face a more stubborn me?"
Chapter 9(2)
Stalking? He positioned himself really accurately. Wen Ning looked at Xiao Chongyuan who was lying facing him with a cold face.
"What conditions?"
"I have to follow you throughout the game."
"That's it?"
"Yes." Xiao Chongyuan nodded heavily, "I will take care of everything for you."
"Really?" Wen Ning looked at him suspiciously.
"Believe me, I said I won't lie to you again." Xiao Chongyuan promised firmly. Seeing Wen Ning's expression soften, he couldn't help but move forward, "Then we can still consider remarriage?"
"We'll talk about it after the competition starts smoothly."
"I won't make trouble, don't worry." Xiao Chongyuan stretched out his hand quietly, "Then..."
"What are you doing? Take your hands away."
"You are going to participate in the modeling competition, so give me some peace of mind."
"What reassurance?" Wen Ning's attention was diverted and he didn't notice that he was gradually squirming.
"You know I don't like beautiful women, and I feel uneasy keeping them at home. Now that you have to go to the competition, I'm even more worried."
Does he mean that he is beautiful? But it sounds weird.
"So I promised to coach you in the game, shouldn't you do something to make me feel at ease?"
"You coaching me in the competition is my test for you, isn't it... Hey, you took your hand away and you still touch it?"
"Come on, wife, let me feel at ease..."
"Who is your wife? Don't scream, ah... can you be honest?"
Xiao Chongyuan suddenly rushed forward, pulled up the quilt and wrapped the two of them up.
The light suddenly became very dark. In the closed space, the warm breaths of the two people were entangled together. Wen Ning dodged Xiao Chongyuan's kiss and simply buried her head in the crook of his neck. He couldn't kiss her red lips, so he used his hands to light fire on her body up and down, and kept kissing her shoulders.
When Wen Ning finally couldn't help but raise her head to take a breath, Xiao Chongyuan immediately moved forward to seal her lips, hooked her uvula, and danced to his own rhythm, "Aning..."
"Hmm...ah." Wen Ning lifted her waist and felt his hotness sliding in, filling her up instantly.
"You are mine." Xiao Chongyuan kissed her deeply and murmured while moving slowly: "You can never run away..."
Under the dim light, the two bodies under the sheets were undulating and entangled.As he moved, the strong movement made the sheets roll up, revealing Xiao Chongyuan's long legs. His knees were against the bed, and his buttocks hit forward forcefully, while Wen Ning's white calves were wrapped around him like helpless vines.
Occasionally, Wen Ning would suddenly stretch out his hand and grab the sheets with force, but was quickly pulled back by Xiao Chongyuan. The big bed creaked due to their movements. The creaking sound and the sexy breathing of the man and woman stopped after a long time.
After signing up for the competition, Wen Ning realized what Xiao Chongyuan had planned.
It was true that he accompanied her throughout the entire journey, but he even found makeup artists and costume stylists for her, all of whom were women, leaving her with no chance of contacting the opposite sex.
How could Wen Ning not understand what he was thinking? He cursed secretly that he was so childish, but he still couldn't help but feel happy.
It's just that everyone is in the same dressing room, and other people's makeup artists are male and female, which makes Xiao Chongyuan feel like he is facing a formidable enemy.
"You're going too far." Wen Ning looked at himself in the makeup mirror, wearing a knee-length cotton nightgown, with a grimace on his face, "It's so hot like this."
Xiao Chongyuan pressed her shoulders, "You can't take it off either. I've already inquired. There are only three men in the judges this time. I just told the staff that you should be placed farthest from the male judges. By the way, there is a judge named Yu Ye. Remember to stay away from him." He said and stretched out his hand to wipe Wen Ning's sweat.
"Why?"
"He is Yu Fang's brother and the organizer of this competition."
"Then shouldn't I get closer?"
"He doesn't know you, so it's useless to get closer." Xiao Chongyuan said angrily: "Don't you have to rely on your own efforts? I won't let you use the back door."
Wen Ning shrugged. He said it so nicely. Anyway, she was not allowed to get close to the opposite sex in a swimsuit.
Although swimsuits were required in this preliminary election, luckily there were no spectators, otherwise Xiao Chongyuan would have been unable to calm down. However, Wen Ning still underestimated Xiao Chongyuan. In the subsequent selections, he forced his friend Yu Ye not to let the audience in during the competition.
"Even if there is no audience, it will still be broadcast live."
"It can be the same if one thing is missing,
"If you mind so much, why don't I help you eliminate her directly? "
“This won’t work. "Xiao Chongyuan refused without thinking.
"Why? "
“Because this is her dream. "
Although he ostracized Wen Ning from participating in the competition, Xiao Chongyuan knew how much effort Wen Ning had put in for this. He could not let the humiliation and grievances she had suffered go in vain just because of his own selfish desires.
If this is really what she wants, then he doesn't want her to have any regrets. What's more, Wen Ning's own conditions are indeed excellent. Putting aside his personal opinions, he feels that she must be the winner of this modeling competition.
She is beautiful, smart and brave. She prepares carefully for every competition, has no stage fright, and performs surprisingly well. Perhaps she has never had stage experience, so she never realized that she is so suitable for this stage.
Xiao Chongyuan felt that his heartbeat was about to stop when he saw Wen Ning standing in the spotlight. The smile on her face, her walking posture, and the range of her hand movements were all impeccable. Each time, she improved at an alarming rate. Even he, who was extremely opposed to her being a model, felt that she might have joined the wrong company from the beginning, which delayed her future.
With her qualifications, it was only a matter of time before she became a top model.
“Thankfully you didn’t take my suggestion at first. " Yu Ye looked at Wen Ning on the stage, "Otherwise our company will miss out on a very outstanding talent. "
Xiao Chongyuan thought thoughtfully, "Do you think she can win the championship? "
Yu Ye touched his chin, "She has the best overall quality among this group of players. She has only competed for three games, and a company is already wanting to sign her. "
Yu Ye withdrew his gaze, "I heard that she had been working for two years before.Model assistant? What kind of boss is he who buried her for two whole years? "
He smiled incomprehensibly, then looked back.
Xiao Chongyuan's face gradually darkened. If he had not been so opposed to Wen Ning's decision before the divorce, maybe she would not have to run away from home in disgrace to realize her dream of becoming a model. Maybe she would have a more respectable start, and she would not have to suffer so much.
Xiao Chongyuan stared deeply at Wen Ning, who was standing in the stage preparation area. His heart, which had been extremely tangled since the beginning of her competition, finally calmed down.
